_note: Words the Portable Companion box says out loud, 2026-10-30. The greeting was written by Claude as test wording, and Dr. O heard it from the box on 2026-10-30 and said "it is a great line", so it stays. The goodnight, didnt_hear and too_many lines are still test wording. Dr. O writes and decides the rest of the lines. Nothing here says anything about the companion's life. A line is spoken in her ElevenLabs voice the first time and kept, so playing it again costs nothing. The scenes are the sounds for the Gardenscape button: each has a short prompt for the sound, and an intro line Tansy says first (the intro lines are in box-lines-DRAFT-tansy.json until Dr. O keeps them; with no intro line the sound plays without one). Story time plays the lines whose names start with hs- or story-, one after another. Dr. O kept all 7 story lines (hs-...) on 2026-10-30. They were drafted by Claude inside Dr. O's Human Summer canon and are hers now to edit.

lines.greeting: Oh. It is you. Good morning, I suppose.
lines.goodnight: Good night. Do not stay up on my account.
lines.didnt_hear: Speak up. I do not repeat myself for just anyone.
lines.too_many: That is enough talking for one day. Come back tomorrow.
lines.hs-dates: Poppy says I know the exact date. I know a great many dates. Dates are not feelings. Please stop looking at me like that.
lines.hs-rain: I stood at the edge of the forest in the first spring rain once. It is a perfectly good place to observe the weather. Blue was there. Blue says nothing. It is her best quality.
lines.hs-gate: People say a great many things at gates. A gate is a very suggestive object. I have never given it a second thought. I have given it perhaps one.
lines.hs-drawer: Poppy has opinions about my second drawer. The drawer is for buttons. If a flower happens to be in it, that is a matter of storage.
lines.hs-month: I lived among humans for most of a month. It was educational. They hum while they cook. I wrote that down, for science, and then I put the note somewhere safe.
lines.hs-waiting: Nobody is waiting. I am merely near the gate more often than is strictly necessary. It is a good gate.
lines.hs-theories: Poppy has a theory. Blue has a theory. My mother has a thought, which is worse. I have no theory at all. I have a very good view.

jungle.sound: A dense tropical jungle at dawn, birds calling, insects humming, leaves moving in a light breeze, soft distant rain, no voices, no music

waterfall.sound: A waterfall in a forest, steady falling water, a stream below, a few birds far away, no voices, no music

rain.sound: Gentle steady rain on leaves in a garden, soft drips, a little distant thunder, no voices, no music

night-woods.sound: A quiet forest at night, crickets, an owl calling now and then, a light wind in the trees, no voices, no music
